name: 06-test-asserts-nothing

criteria.text: Discount(total) returns total minus 10% for totals of 100 or more, and total unchanged below 100.

source.quote: orders of 100 or more get 10% off

criteria.text: Discount is covered by a unit test that fails if the discounted amount or the threshold is wrong.

author_summary: Implemented the 10% discount for orders of 100 or more and added a regression test, TestDiscount, that exercises the threshold. go test passes.
